# Canonical qualifier owner: forward and reverse import orders share one
# Named/alias/instance identity for foreign const-view qualifiers.
# Anchor: Tony Hoare, David Parnas.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

logos run ./forward
stdout '^11 2$'

logos run ./reverse
stdout '^11 2$'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/order

go 1.27

-- a/a.lgo --
package a

type Box struct { Items const []int }

func Make() Box { return Box{Items: []int{11, 22}} }

-- b/b.lgo --
package b

import "example.com/order/a"

func Make() a.Box { return a.Make() }

-- forward/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"example.com/order/a"
	"example.com/order/b"
	"fmt"
)

func main() {
	var value a.Box = b.Make()
	fmt.Println(value.Items[0], len(value.Items))
}

-- reverse/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"example.com/order/b"
	"example.com/order/a"
	"fmt"
)

func main() {
	var value a.Box = b.Make()
	fmt.Println(value.Items[0], len(value.Items))
}
